append.detail: 2026-11-27 (SCAN-1344): the public Calendar tab stopped carrying its own team mode, per the owner ruling of 2026-11-25 ("Public only, link to team"). The team half of this row now lives on the team calendar at /spaces/<slug>/settings/calendar; the probe was rewritten to measure that. 2026-11-27 (owner chose Ask Vera on the team calendar): the check now measures the real Vera, not the command bar parser that only shares its placeholder wording.
